notes: Step 1 was wrong in one place: I added wire21 (Uno GND.2 to the bottom ground rail). The bottom-half B pins and the bottom LED cathodes use the bottom ground rail, and a separate ground feed to it is needed. All other parts are unchanged.

The manual gives no wire layout, so the breadboard positions are my own. The AD5206 sits across the centre gap with pins 1-12 in holes 5t.e to 16t.e, left to right, and pins 24 down to 13 in holes 5b.f to 16b.f. Pin 1 faces pin 24.

All six A pins and VDD go to the +5V rail. A1-A4 are on the bottom half, so their wires run to the top + rail. All six B pins go to ground: B5 and B6 to the top - rail, B1-B4 to the bottom - rail. VSS and the GND pin go to the top - rail. The top - rail and bottom - rail are both fed from Uno ground.
CS goes to Uno pin 10, SDI to pin 11 and CLK to pin 13, as the code comments say.

Each channel's W pin goes through a 220 ohm resistor to the LED anode. The LED cathode goes to a ground rail. Channels 1-6 use led1-led6 and r1-r6. The resistor is on the anode side, as in the schematic.
The wiper (W) is used as the voltage-divider output. The ad5206 part's 'through' pairs model the A-W and W-B resistor tracks, so there are no edges inside the chip.
Bank 'b' rows are f-j and bank 't' rows are a-e. Rail hole numbers are arbitrary, because each rail is one strip.
